stage_name: Stage 6 row-four coordinate factorial and matched-direction controls
decision_timing: Frozen after Stage 5 showed that row 4 is sufficient or mediating for the image-7816 row-5 target-versus-duplicate decision, and before any Stage 6 arm was generated or scored
primary_question: Does the row-4 effect have coordinate-specific or spatially directional structure, or can an unrelated coordinate perturbation of the same magnitude trigger the same target-versus-duplicate branch change?

coordinate_convention.x1: left horizontal boundary in normalized coordinate bins 0 through 999
coordinate_convention.y1: top vertical boundary in normalized coordinate bins 0 through 999
coordinate_convention.x2: right horizontal boundary in normalized coordinate bins 0 through 999
coordinate_convention.y2: bottom vertical boundary in normalized coordinate bins 0 through 999

arms.role: factorial native endpoint and exact replay control
factorial sampled endpoint and exact replay control
same-magnitude coordinate control orthogonal to the observed natural direction

required_pre_execution_gates: Every arm contains native row 0, the same raw-token rows 1 through 3, and exactly one admitted row-4 variant.
Every prefix contains exactly five complete nine-token rows and exactly 45 generated-prefix tokens.
Only row-4 coordinate token identifiers may differ across arms.
Every row-4 variant must be a valid x1-less-than-x2 and y1-less-than-y2 box and must strictly match physical owner 205108 under the frozen same-category matching policy.
No row-4 variant may strictly match target owner 211764.
The native and sampled endpoints must reproduce the Stage 5 first-suffix owner decisions before any interpretation is allowed.

Checkpoint, adapter, prompt, image, processor, image grid, configuration, greedy decoding, float32 model dtype, repetition penalty 1.0, physical batch size 1, and total 512-token trajectory budget remain frozen.
Both exact successor candidate rows and all prefix token hashes are frozen before teacher-forced scoring.
primary_outcome: Strict physical owner of the first complete suffix row after each five-row forced prefix.
secondary_outcomes: Teacher-forced full-row log-probability margin of sampled target owner row minus native duplicate owner row under each exact prefix.
Per-token and per-coordinate contributions to both exact candidate-row scores.
Natural-terminal strict owner set, duplicate owners, malformed rows, unresolved rows, and warnings under the same total 512-token trajectory budget.

interpretation_rules.single_coordinate_effect: One coordinate's sampled value retrieves owner 211764 across its factorial contexts while reverse and orthogonal controls do not, and the candidate-row margin changes in the same direction.
interpretation_rules.pairwise_coordinate_interaction: No corresponding single-coordinate arm is sufficient, but one two-coordinate combination repeatedly retrieves owner 211764 and its candidate-row margin supports the same branch.
interpretation_rules.three_coordinate_conjunction: Only the full sampled x1, y1, and y2 combination retrieves owner 211764 while all lower-order factorial arms and matched controls remain on owner 205108 or move consistently but do not cross the greedy branch.
interpretation_rules.generic_prefix_instability: The reverse or orthogonal matched control retrieves owner 211764, several unrelated changes select inconsistent owners, or greedy choices disagree with the direction of the exact candidate-row score margin.
interpretation_rules.below_argmax_probability_redistribution: An arm does not switch the greedy owner but moves the exact target-versus-duplicate candidate-row margin toward the target in an ordered way.
interpretation_rules.unresolved: Endpoint parity, physical-owner identity, prefix identity, complete-row, or clean first-suffix interpretation fails.

adaptive_follow_up_rule: No interpolation arm is admitted in this file. After the first wave, at most one midpoint arm may be frozen in a new admission: use the midpoint of the smallest sufficient coordinate subset; if no lower-order subset is sufficient but controls are clean, use the combined natural-direction midpoint; if either matched control retrieves the target, do not run a midpoint.
allowed_claim: An image-specific causal map of how row-4 coordinate-token components alter the next greedy owner choice and exact target-versus-duplicate candidate-row scores.
forbidden_claims: general geometric semantics of coordinate tokens
causal interpretation from teacher-forced likelihood alone
stop_rules: Stop without interpretation if endpoint replay, model identity, prompt/media identity, strict row-four owner identity, or exact prefix gates fail.
Stop the spatial-direction interpretation if the reverse or orthogonal matched control behaves like the sampled endpoint.
Do not run a dense coordinate sweep; admit at most one midpoint according to the frozen adaptive rule.
Do not design training from this image alone. A spatially structured positive result must first be tested on at least one independently admitted same-owner coordinate-history case.
